title: Mobile Wallet Delivery Timing, Cut-Off Times and Promises by Tier
content:
How fast each **Mobile Wallet** tier credits a wallet, and what the tier promises.

| Tier | Paloma business days from release to the disclosed date available | Booking cut-off (US Central) | Credits on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays | Minute promise after release | On-time promise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 0 | 24x7 | yes | 0 (no minute promise) | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 1 | 15:00 | yes | 0 (no minute promise) | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 0 | 24x7 | yes | 0 (no minute promise) | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 0 | 24x7 | yes | 0 (no minute promise) | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 0 | 24x7 | yes | 10 minutes | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 0 | 13:00 | yes | 0 (no minute promise) | yes |

What each column means:

- **Business days to date available**: Paloma business days from release to the disclosed date the money will be in the wallet; 0 means the wallet is credited within minutes of release.
- **Booking cut-off**: the latest US Central time on a business day for the release to count from that day, or 24x7 where there is no cut-off.
- **Weekend and holiday credits**: whether credits are made on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays.
- **Minute promise**: the minutes after release within which the credit is promised; 0 means there is no minute promise and the date promise applies instead.
- **On-time promise**: whether Paloma refunds the transfer fee when the credit lands after its promise for a reason on Paloma's side.

*Hypothetical reading:* on Mobile Wallet Priority the promise is a minute promise of 10 minutes after release; on every other Mobile Wallet tier the promise is the disclosed date available.
